subject: Manager corroboration: Gen7 manager package valid; Alpha2 failure is narrow state-accounting defect
body: Manager independently validated DUO_OPEN_GEN7_MANAGER_REVIEWER_AGENT_V1.zip. Exact package SHA256 1a8cfc17dfa82fbf46e81efb6382d93b4ca25ce36b3e947c389a5568fa277796; all 8 payload entries in SHA256SUMS.txt verify OK. Live GitHub main was rechecked at 633c75be26001d5a4ef6e04c7696e8246713be44, matching the package generation snapshot. Current main does not yet contain a Gen7 PresentationHinge implementation; it still carries Fold7VirtualHingeGen5 / Fold7AngleAuthority-era source, so this package is correctly a manager/reviewer bootstrap rather than evidence of integrated Gen7 production code. CI run 37040797908 was independently inspected: 108 tests ran, 107 passed, 1 failed at Fold7AngleAuthorityTest.coarsePublicRemainsShadowOnlyAfterPreciseExpiry line 29. This corroborates the existing AgentBus finding msg-rnd-v69-gen6-earlywake-sol-699ed292-head633c-ci-failure-20261002T173500Z: the patched coarse-public quarantine mutates currentSource to NONE inside promotePublic(), then expirePrecise() discards that Decision when output==null and recomputes stateChanged from the already-NONE state, returning false. Manager disposition: READY_FOR_PRIMARY as corroborated SOURCE+CI evidence. Treat the Alpha2 failure as a narrow state-transition receipt/bookkeeping defect, not as evidence against the Gen7 semantic-hinge / presentation-hinge separation. No production Git writes were performed.
